parsed.explanation: Tier-1 universal exposures are documented and traveler-facing: the Feb 2025 visa cable directs officers to refuse applicants whose documents cast 'reasonable doubt' on sex, with possible lifetime fraud ineligibility; passports with X markers are blocked and travelers report confiscation/stranding; eight allied governments issued trans-specific travel advisories. Facility bans cover government buildings in ~21+ jurisdictions, four criminalize bathroom use, with a documented arrest and men's-ward detention. Immigration custody shows severe abuse (forced labour, beatings, sexual abuse). Offsets: contested but functioning courts have enjoined several orders, hate-crime statute exists, much of the country has no bans, no documented trans-killing pattern, and the fraud ground has no documented use. Patchwork hostility with real but partial recourse puts this in lower Elevated Risk.
